title: [ingest] ExtensionError re-exported from sphinx.util via __getattr__ is deprecated
summary: `sphinx.util.ExtensionError` was never intentionally public but was historically accessible. It is now exposed only via a `__getattr__` lazy-import fallback in `sphinx/util/__init__.py` and is slated for removal. The canonical import path is `sphinx.errors.ExtensionError`. Third-party extensions importing from `sphinx.util` will get a deprecation warning.
